title: Tunisian Couscous Tagine
description: A hearty North African stew made with tender meat, flavorful spices, and fluffy couscous.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the couscous and cook, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the olives and cook for 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
